context.body: A long sequence imagines covenant failure before it happens.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The prayer asks God to judge, forgive, teach, send rain, hear foreigners, support battle, and restore exiles.
observations.label: Solomon prays across guilt, disaster, exile, and foreigners: action

observations.body: Israel, individuals, foreigners, armies, and captives appear as possible petitioners.
observations.label: Solomon prays across guilt, disaster, exile, and foreigners: response

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 8:31–53 as ark, prayer, and dedication evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The prayer expects both judgment and forgiveness without making the Temple a shield from consequence.
payload.title: Solomon prays across guilt, disaster, exile, and foreigners
